app.name: ChessAdvisor
app.tagline: Learn chess by playing OpenAI models

play.title: Play a game
play.body: The board, the opponent card and the eval bar appear here as soon as the game is ready.
play.noGameBody: Pick model, difficulty and colour: board, eval bar and move list appear here.
play.browsing: You are reviewing an earlier position.
play.engineUnavailable: Stockfish is unavailable: the eval bar is hidden.

empty.note: available after your first analysed game

training.title: Training built on your games
training.body: Tactics, openings and endgames picked from the themes where you lose the most points.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.body: Estimated level, accuracy and improving themes, computed from the games you played.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, language and Codex connection.
settings.themeHint: The system theme follows your Windows preference.
settings.modelsHint: Preselection of the New game dialog; difficulty stays independent.
settings.defaultModelHint: Used for the opponent and, unless the coach is separate, for the coach too.
settings.defaultEffortHint: The available efforts depend on the model you pick.
settings.separateCoachHint: Let the coach answer with a different model or effort than the opponent.
settings.codexHint: Games run through your Codex session, in a dedicated folder.
settings.codexMismatch: The CLI version differs from the one this build was tested with: update Codex if something misbehaves.
settings.codexBlocked: Ordinary usage is paused: wait for the quota to reset.
settings.engineHint: Stockfish powers the eval bar and the analyses.
settings.engineNote: Without the engine the eval bar stays hidden and analyses are unavailable.

updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: The app updates from the project GitHub releases, with SHA-256 verification of the installer.
updates.autoCheckHint: One check 15 seconds after start and then every 6 hours, only with a connected GitHub account.
updates.releaseChanged: The release changed or the download is not ready. Check for updates again.
updates.promptBody: Download and install version {{version}}? When the download finishes the app closes and restarts on its own.
updates.promptKeep: Games, profile and settings are preserved. You can postpone and update from Settings.

about.title: About and licences
about.codexTestedHint: The version the protocol types were generated from and the app was tested against.
about.noticesHint: Stockfish, chessground, chess.js, cburnett pieces, fonts and Lichess datasets.

newGame.title: New game
newGame.modelHint: The model plays through your Codex session.
newGame.effortHint: The available efforts change with the model you pick.
newGame.difficultyHint: Difficulty only changes the opponent persona, never the model or the effort.
newGame.hintLowEffort: At levels 1-3 a low or medium effort is enough and answers faster.
newGame.hintHighEffort: Maximum is best paired with a high effort.
newGame.commentsVisibleHint: The coach comments the moves as you play, in the Comments tab.
newGame.showReasoningHint: Streams the opponent reasoning summary while it thinks.
newGame.noModels: No model available: check the Codex connection.
newGame.failed: The game could not be started.

starting.title: Connecting to Codex
starting.body: Starting the app-server in the dedicated ChessAdvisor folder.
starting.label: Starting

notInstalled.title: Codex CLI not found
notInstalled.body: ChessAdvisor plays through the Codex CLI already installed on your computer. Paths searched:
notInstalled.download: How to install the Codex CLI
notInstalled.label: CLI not found

notAuthenticated.title: Codex session not authenticated
notAuthenticated.body: Open a terminal, run the command below, complete the sign-in in your browser, then retry.
notAuthenticated.label: Not authenticated

notIsolated.title: Codex environment is not isolated
notIsolated.body: The dedicated folder is not configured as expected: games stay blocked until you confirm.
notIsolated.label: Environment not isolated

crashed.title: The Codex app-server stopped
crashed.body: The process exited unexpectedly. The game in progress is already saved on disk.
crashed.label: Stopped

opponent.title: Opponent
opponent.reroutedHint: The server answered with a model other than the one you chose.

controls.resignBody: The game ends immediately as a loss and stays in the archive.

coach.name: Coach
coach.commentsHidden: Turn them back on and the coach comments again from the next move.
coach.noComments: No comment yet: the first one arrives after the next move.
coach.question: Ask the coach
coach.questionPlaceholder: What plan should I follow in this position?
coach.emptyTitle: The coach is here for you
coach.empty: Ask a question or request a hint: the coach answers here.
coach.noOracleHint: The coach reasons without Stockfish evaluations.

clock.title: Clock
clock.hint: The main process owns the time: it is computed by difference of timestamps, never by counting ticks.
clock.alsoAi: A clock for the AI too
clock.modeHint: With “Only my time” the opponent plays without a clock: you are the only one racing it.
clock.warningTitle: Little time for a high effort
clock.warningBody: With {{preset}} and {{effort}} effort the model may well flag while it is thinking. Choose how to go on.

archive.title: Games
archive.subtitle: Resume an interrupted game or delete the ones you no longer need.
archive.emptyBody: The games you play stay here: resume the interrupted ones and review the finished ones.
archive.deleteBody: The game and its analysis are removed from disk. This cannot be undone.
archive.failed: The game could not be resumed.
archive.substituteBody: The game used {{model}}, which is no longer listed. Pick the model to continue with.
archive.noMatchBody: Change one filter, or clear them all to see the whole list again.

review.title: Review
review.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted: go back to the games and pick another one.
review.notAnalysed: This game has not been analysed yet.
review.unavailable: Stockfish is unavailable: move comments and the coach's lesson still work.
review.moveListAria: Moves of the game: use the left and right arrows to navigate
review.moveNotAnalysed: This move has not been analysed yet.
review.startHint: Starting position: pick a move to see its detail.
review.keyMomentsEmpty: No serious mistake: no key moment to review.
review.keyMomentsPending: Key moments appear once the analysis has run.
review.lessonEmpty: Ask for the lesson of the game: three takeaways and a summary.
review.graphAria: Evaluation graph, {{count}} plies; the line is White's winning chance

progress.title: Your progress
progress.subtitle: Level, accuracy, themes and openings drawn from the games you had analysed.
progress.confidenceHint: Confidence grows with the number of analysed games and with how steady the results look.
progress.confidenceAria: Confidence of the estimate: {{value}} per cent
progress.qualitativeEmpty: The coach rewrites the assessment every three analysed games; “Update” asks for it right away.
progress.trendAria_one: Accuracy of the only analysed game, on a scale from 0 to 100
progress.trendAria_other: Accuracy of the last {{count}} analysed games, oldest to most recent, on a scale from 0 to 100
progress.trendEmpty: No analysed game yet: the chart appears after the first review.
progress.classificationsHint_other: average over the last {{count}} analysed games
progress.classificationsEmpty: Classifications appear once a game has been analysed.
progress.barAria: {{label}}: {{percent}} per cent of your moves, {{value}} per game
progress.weakThemesHint: the five most frequent in your key moments
progress.weakThemesEmpty: No theme labelled yet: the coach assigns them when you analyse a game.
progress.openingsHint: accuracy over the first ten plies

training.title: Training
training.subtitle: Exercises from your own games, tactics by theme, openings, endgames and the coach’s study plan.

exercise.promptW: Find the best move for White
exercise.promptB: Find the best move for Black
exercise.correctAlternative: Correct move: an equally good alternative.
exercise.wrong: That is not the best move. Look at the position again and try once more.
exercise.over: This exercise is over: restart it to play it again.
exercise.none: Pick an exercise from the list.

own.title: Exercises from your games
own.hint: They come from the mistakes the engine found in the games you had analysed.
own.emptyBody: Play a game and have it analysed: the mistakes that cost you most become exercises to replay.

thematic.title: Tactics by theme
thematic.hint: The coach picks the theme and the rating window from your profile, then the library draws ten puzzles.
thematic.fallback: Set chosen by rotation: the coach needs more analysed games to choose it.
thematic.emptyBody: A set is ten puzzles on the same theme, taken from the lichess database.
thematic.empty: No puzzle is available for this theme.

openings.title: Your openings
openings.hint: Recognised from the position, with the deviations from theory you repeat most often.
openings.emptyBody: Openings show up here after the first game has been analysed.
openings.deviationsEmpty: No recurring deviation in this opening.

endgames.title: Canonical endgames
endgames.hint: Play opens a game from the position, against the opponent at the highest level.
endgames.emptyBody: The endgame catalogue was not loaded: try again in a moment.

plan.title: Study plan
plan.hint: Four to eight activities the coach chooses from what your profile says.
plan.emptyBody: The coach lines up the exercises, the openings and the endgames to start from, each with its reason.
plan.generating: The coach is writing the plan…
plan.invalid: The material of this activity is gone: the generic activity is left.
plan.staleGames_one: You have played {{count}} game since the plan was written: it is worth regenerating it.
plan.staleGames_other: You have played {{count}} games since the plan was written: it is worth regenerating it.
plan.staleRefs_one: {{count}} activity points at material that is gone: it is worth regenerating the plan.
plan.staleRefs_other: {{count}} activities point at material that is gone: it is worth regenerating the plan.
plan.summaryEmpty: The coach has not written a study plan yet.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: They work everywhere, except while you are typing in a text field.
shortcuts.moves: Previous and next move, in the game and in the review
shortcuts.ends: Jump to the starting position or back to the last one
shortcuts.promotion: Pick the promotion piece: queen, knight, rook, bishop
shortcuts.escape: Close the open dialog, or cancel the promotion
shortcuts.tab: Move to the next group; the arrows move between the tabs
